definition: Techniques for reducing the number of input variables in a dataset while preserving as much meaningful information as possible.
details: Common methods include Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and t-SNE, used for visualization, noise reduction, and improving downstream model efficiency.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. That care with the raw material is Dimensionality Reduction.
